evidence.title: routes go around known obstacles and fail when the way is shut
what River has not seen cannot be a target

evidence.title: river travels, arrives, gets hungry, rests and recovers energy
generations: a new life makes earlier work stale
a tool call from a previous life changes nothing and is journaled nowhere
a new life clears personal beliefs, attachments and what was unseen
plant grows and calendar day advances with the tick, not wall time
a charging predator stops the errand and River runs, before any thinking
fire turns fuel into a little ash and never makes material from nothing; a soaked thing resists
a glowing coal lying against dry fuel sets it alight; a cold stone does not
a build is spent stage by stage: nothing before a stage is done, and what is spent shows in what stands
a structure worn through falls down into part of what it was, and no more
picking up, putting down and wearing keep an item what it is
containers hold what fits, never themselves, and never in a loop
parts are matched by what they can do, not by name
sewing goes through the recipe engine: exactly the pieces a garment takes, and where they came from is kept
what River is shown stays within its budget, and costs far less than a transcript would
a performance is counted once and its effects land at the end
a stirred heart remembers more firmly; tolerance stays inside its bounds
the built-in plugins run in the sandbox and their results apply cleanly, or fail with the reason the old path gave
presets are recorded commands that set known parameters, and 'standard' returns to the defaults
a generated plugin runs only as installed: unpinned, changed or re-pinned
a plugin cannot reach the process, files, the network, timers or eval
a failing provider is retried without doing anything twice, and a late answer from a previous life changes nothing
a client builds on a snapshot, takes broadcasts in order, ignores old ones, and asks again on a gap
every parameter says who owns it, how it may change, what ruleset it belongs to, and stays inside its own bounds
an empty allowance: ordinary decisions wait, a human's words still get through the reserve, and the world waits
snapshot/restore continues identically (including RNG and pending jobs)
advancing is the same as stepping: every checkpoint hash matches an ordinary run, to a tick count and to dawn
losing something River made and named weighs far more than losing a stock item of the same kind
something that happens out of sight cannot be grieved until River comes upon it
a drawn item is exactly the documented size, standing on the ground, and its collision bounds agree
when River dies the whole life is written down, with its cause, before anything is wiped
a new life starts blank, but the old life's summary is kept
